findings.summary: Map pan and zoom shortcuts cannot currently be disabled or remapped while the Carte tab is active.
findings.fix: Consider an explicit map-control focus or preference that enables, disables, or remaps the arrow and zoom shortcuts.
findings.evidence: The shortcuts are now limited to the Carte tab and are listed in the map's on-screen keyboard hint, but no disable or remap option exists.

passed: Tab cycles province focus; Enter and Space activate the focused province.
The focus outline is rendered independently of hover and selection.
Auto-fit, resize, pan, and zoom keep a focused province visible.
Pan and zoom shortcuts are scoped to the Carte tab and documented in the view.
Tests cover map fitting, clipping, focus, selection, and polygon rendering.
notes: Keyboard behavior was reviewed in source and tests; no native Horizon build or in-game interaction was performed.
